In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 5. 8S rRNA and ITS-1 and 2 sequences in Tr. urarta are highly conserved in comparison with those of other plants.
the 5. 8S rDNA gene and ITS sequences of diploid wheat Tr. urarta are similar to the corresponding sequences in hexaploid bread wheat and other cereals.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the nucleotide sequences of 18S rRNA, 5.8 rRNA and 28S rRNA in Tr. uratru are highly homologous with the sequences of rice and maize, but the nucleotide sequences in the ITS regions of rDNA are more similar to the sequences of rice than to the sequences of maize.
5. 8S rRNA of Triticum uratu and internal transcribed spacer ITS-2 are highly conservative, but the ITS-1 region is more variable and has an insertion.
the structure of 5. 8S rRNA and rDNA internal spacer regions in Tr. uratu is similar to that of rice and maize, but differs from the corresponding regions in hexaploid bread wheat.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that 5S rRNA genes are located within the 5' end of the 18S rRNA gene, in the same manner as in the other species studied.
the structure of 5.5S rRNA gene in diploid wheat is identical to 5.5 rRNA gene in hexaploid species of this genus.
the structure of rDNA in Tr. urarta is close to the structure of rRNA in other monocotyledonous plants.
